paragraphs: The tanna of Menasheh’s school. See the entry Rav Menashya of Dovil (מדויל).[^1]

notes.text: מדויל continues the target name across the line break and is read as “of Dovil.” Its exact reading and geographical identification remain uncertain; the English does not identify a modern location. Rav is written in full.
